overloadMerges.note: row accepts either a positive break/subtotal level or one of the documented negative sentinel constants (qr title/detail/grand total); modeled as sentinelValues.

params.name: row
params.description: Row designator: a positive subtotal (break) level, or a negative constant designating a special report area

sentinelValues.meaning: qr title -- title area of the report
qr detail -- detail area of the report
qr grand total -- grand total area

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Shows or hides the given row (or special report area) of the report.
